name: Fitness/Workout
description: High-energy workout guide with warm-up, main session, and cooldown structure. Motivational tone, timer overlays, and form callouts.
voice_style: motivational, authoritative but encouraging, athletic — like a trainer who pushes you but respects your limits
music_mood: electronic workout beats, high-energy EDM, motivational pop

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: 10-minute full-body workout — no equipment, no excuses. You have time. Do it with me.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Open floor space, workout clothes on, timer displayed on screen, person bouncing on heels ready to start, athletic pose
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up static, slight push-in on energy, confident athletic stance
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright gym-style overhead lighting, high contrast, energetic cool-white light with slight blue tint
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: High energy from frame one; athletic pose and timer overlay signal 'structured workout' credibility

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Warm-up first — 60 seconds of jumping jacks, 30 seconds of arm circles, 30 seconds of hip circles. Get the blood moving.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person doing jumping jacks, wide shot of room, close-up of face showing determination, timer overlay counting down
scene_sequence.camera_movement: wide shot for jumping jacks, cut to medium for arm circles, static wide for hip circles
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright overhead gym lighting, slight side fill to show muscle movement, high energy cool tones
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Wide-to-medium cuts match the fast warm-up energy; timer overlay is expected for workout content

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Circuit one — 10 squats, 10 push-ups, 10 lunges each side. Rest 30 seconds between rounds. Three rounds total.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Squat form close-up, push-up form from side angle, lunge form from front, countdown timer on screen, sweat dripping
scene_sequence.camera_movement: side angle for push-ups (essential for form), front angle for squats and lunges, macro detail on sweat
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: side key light to reveal muscle definition clearly, slight lens flare for energy, sweat glint detail
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Side angle for push-ups is non-negotiable — form visibility is credibility; sweat detail adds realism

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Circuit two — plank hold 45 seconds, mountain climbers 30 seconds, burpees 10. You made it this far. Finish it.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Plank position held, mountain climber feet close-up, burpee jump, person breathing hard, clock ticking
scene_sequence.camera_movement: side angle for plank and mountain climbers, front close-up for burpee jump, macro on breathing hard face
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: dynamic lighting matching intensity: brighter for burpees, focused side light for plank hold
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Hard breathing face close-up is the emotional peak — it signals 'I did this too' relatability

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Cool down — stretch your hip flexors, hamstrings, and chest. Hold each stretch for 30 seconds. Breathing is key here.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Floor stretching positions, close-up of hamstring stretch, person breathing deeply, calm ambient feel
scene_sequence.camera_movement: smooth slow cuts between stretch positions, static hold during stretch, slow tilt to face
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warmer softer lighting than main workout, calm blue tones, diffused overhead
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Cool-down lighting shift from cool-intense to warm-calm signals the rhythm change subconsciously

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: You just did a full workout in 10 minutes. That counts. Drink water, eat protein, and go crush your day.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person sitting on floor smiling, water bottle in hand, sweat on forehead, workout summary graphic with checkmarks
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up on seated person, slow push-in on smile, pull-back to show context
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm triumphant lighting, soft and welcoming, slight lens flare for victory feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Victory moment — person on floor smiling is relatable and triumphant; water bottle detail signals post-workout authenticity
